svg.aria-label: Engineering reports. Measurements from my own products, each with its data and scripts. 119× shorter waits behind slow requests after one lock fix: Testing PostgreSQL Tenant Isolation (WayClub). 97% of float-based ledgers ended up not adding up: Cent-Exact Ledger (Bupples). 8 bugs around clock changes that the existing tests missed: One Rule, Three Runtimes (Adelante). 4× lower frame rate once face tracking switches on: Sixteen Milliseconds (Photoshoot).
